title: My preparation session
resumeHelp: Checkpoints and reasons are personal. Funding reloads the current content, decisions and evidence.
outsideFilter: Service moved outside this filter · {{count}} matching services
finishHelp: Finishing retains decisions and checkpoints. You can explicitly resume this session later.
discardConfirm: Discard personal entries and unsaved changes? Decisions and content already saved in Funding are retained.
personalHelp: Saving a checkpoint retains your position and personal reason; it neither saves nor publishes website content.
decisionConfirmed: Decision recorded. You can continue reviewing.
resumed: Session resumed; retained counters describe its activity since it started.
sourceChanged: The source changed since this checkpoint. Review the current preparation before deciding; the older entry is not applied to its content.
draftSaved: Private draft saved. Saving grants no publication authorization.
webReadOnly: This website preview remains read-only. Personal checkpoints do not change the public presentation.
localCopyHelp: This service can no longer be edited in the workshop. You can still read and copy your entries below; they do not replace the content saved in Funding.
unsavedHelp: The social draft is saved by its owning service. Your position and reason are saved as personal checkpoints.

errors.conflict: This session changed in another tab. Your entries are retained; reload the session before continuing.
errors.uncertain: Saving is not confirmed. Your entries are retained. Reload the result before continuing; no command is automatically repeated.
errors.unavailable: The session is unavailable. Preparations remain readable; personal saving is not reported as successful.
errors.forbidden: Your session or role no longer allows this save. Sign in again if needed.

metricScope: Approvals and corrections: this session’s activity. To resume and awaiting delivery: current state; these counters are not added together.
noActivity: No activity has been recorded in this session.
